recent_posts.title: Common AWS serverless pitfalls that cause silent data loss
recent_posts.summary: Serverless development on AWS contains numerous pitfalls that can cause silent data loss, duplication, and unpredictable behavior. DynamoDB has gotchas leading to data loss and misleading results. Event-driven architectures suffer from misconfigured queues, dead-letter queues, and misunderstood EventBridge behaviors. Common serverless design patterns can cause event duplication, out-of-order processing, and data inconsistency. The session shares real-world failures and practical advice for building resilient serverless systems.

recent_posts.title: CDK Booster - Speeding Up Bundling of Lambda Handlers
recent_posts.summary: CDK Booster is a tool that accelerates AWS CDK builds by bundling all Lambda functions simultaneously instead of sequentially. It works as a drop-in replacement requiring only npm installation and a small cdk.json modification. The tool prevents duplicate bundling when CDK synthesis runs multiple times and uses ESbuild's multiple entry points for significant speed improvements, particularly beneficial for large projects with many TypeScript/JavaScript Lambda functions.

recent_posts.title: Debugging serverless applications with Lambda Live Debugger and CloudWatch techniques
recent_posts.summary: Lambda Live Debugger enables debugging AWS Lambda functions directly from your local machine while they run in the cloud, maintaining IAM permissions without requiring redeployment. The presentation also covers debugging techniques for serverless applications using tools like Lambda Logger Extension and Lambda Error SNS Sender, plus CloudWatch optimization strategies to simplify the traditionally complex serverless debugging process.

recent_posts.title: Lambda Live Debugger vs Official AWS Remote Debugging
recent_posts.summary: AWS has introduced official Lambda remote debugging, which is compared against Lambda Live Debugger. The official AWS solution supports multiple languages but requires code uploads and only works with VS Code. Lambda Live Debugger offers advantages like TypeScript support with automatic transpiling, no code uploads needed, multi-Lambda debugging, real event capture, and framework integration. The official solution excels for VPC access and Python/Java support, while Lambda Live Debugger provides better developer experience for JavaScript/TypeScript workflows.

recent_posts.title: How I passed 5 AWS certifications in 5 days: 15 essential tips
recent_posts.summary: In January 2025, the author successfully renewed five AWS certifications over five days, including both associate and professional levels. They share 15 essential tips for efficiently preparing and passing these challenging exams, emphasizing high-quality courses, strategic study schedules, time management, and leveraging resources like community programs and discounts. The certifications help understand the AWS ecosystem, but hands-on experience is crucial for real-world application.

recent_posts.title: Add Logging to AWS Lambda Without Redeploying Using a Simple Extension
recent_posts.summary: Debugging AWS Lambda functions in production can be challenging due to insufficient logging. Temporarily enabling logging without redeploying is possible using a Lambda extension that supports Node.js. This extension, originating from tools like Lambda Live Debugger and ServerlessSpy, allows critical logging with minimal impact on the codebase. Detailed steps to build and use the extension, including setting environment variables and updating handlers, are provided. Important considerations include compatibility issues with other internal extensions.

recent_posts.title: Query DynamoDB with SQL using Athena - Leveraging EventBridge Pipes and Firehose (2/2)
recent_posts.summary: This post explains how to stream data from DynamoDB to S3 using EventBridge Pipes and Firehose, enabling SQL queries with Athena. It highlights the advantages of using Firehose, like data transformation to Parquet format for optimized storage and query performance. The guide covers real-time data flow, potential challenges, and provides a sample project with CDK and TypeScript, demonstrating integration steps and Athena queries. Key points include handling real-time data, dealing with duplicates, and setting up an efficient reporting architecture.

recent_posts.title: Query DynamoDB with SQL using Athena - Leveraging DynamoDB Exports to S3 (1/2)
recent_posts.summary: This post explains how to copy data from DynamoDB to S3 and query it with Athena using SQL. It discusses the benefits and limitations of DynamoDB, the advantages of using Athena for serverless data analytics, and outlines two methods for transferring data: native full or incremental exports and using EventBridge Pipes and Firehose. The post includes a sample project built with AWS CDK and TypeScript, demonstrating daily report generation with both full and incremental exports.

recent_posts.title: Serverless Developer Experience is Finally Great with Lambda Live Debugger
recent_posts.summary: Lambda Live Debugger is an open-source tool that simplifies the debugging of AWS Lambda functions by allowing local debugging of deployed functions. It supports JavaScript, TypeScript, and various frameworks, eliminating the need for redeployment. Key features include an interactive setup wizard, fast switching between debugging and regular execution, targeted debugging of specific Lambdas, and an Observability Mode for debugging in shared environments. The tool is compatible with CDK, Serverless Framework v3, AWS SAM, and Terraform, among others.

recent_posts.summary: Learn how to export CDK to CloudFormation, the reasons for doing so, and discover various CDK escape hatches that can be useful in certain scenarios.
